properties.displayName: CCC.KeyMgmt.CN02 - Key vaults must use Azure RBAC authorization
properties.description: Audits key vaults that still use legacy vault access policies instead of Azure RBAC, which is required for granular per-operation (e.g. decrypt) least-privilege scoping. Maps to FINOS CCC KeyMgmt CN02 (Limit Decrypt Permissions) and enforces the AVM key-vault sample setting 'legacy_access_policies_enabled = false' (RBAC authorization model).

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
